In US for veterinary use only. USP 31 (Sulfadimethoxine). Practically white, crystalline pow- der. Practically insoluble in water; slightly soluble in alcohol, in chloroform, in ether, and in hexane; soluble in 2N sodium hy- droxide; sparingly soluble in 2N hydrochloric acid. Store in air- tight containers. Protect from light. Profile Sulfadimethoxine is a long-acting sulfonamide with properties similar to those of sulfamethoxazole (p.340). It is used in prepa- rations for the treatment of skin infections and was formerly used for the treatment of urinary-tract infections.
